ApiUrl.description: This is the URL of the API that will run the tests.

TestBaseUrl.description: The base URL to run tests against.

SiteBaseUrls.description: Per-site base URL overrides for multisite/headless installs, keyed by each root node's Key (Guid). Checked before the single global TestBaseUrl fallback.

UserGroups.description: The user groups that can use Accessibility Reporter.

ExcludedDocTypes.description: Document types to exclude Accessibility Reporter from being displayed.

RunTestsAutomatically.description: Set if the tests should run as soon as users open a content node.

MaxCacheAgeHours.description: Maximum age, in hours, of the last stored test run before it's treated as stale and a fresh test is run instead of displaying it. 0 or less disables the age check.

IncludeIfNoTemplate.description: Set if you want to include content without templates.

MaxPages.description: The maximum number of pages to run the multipage tests on.
